assumptions: Alda:2026nrd tree pseudoscalar source masses and matrices
diagonal measurement covariances and independent experiment blocks
full published hard spacelike ranges are conditional model diagnostics
profile shared total widths and BaBar 2.3 percent normalization
canonical coefficients negated for legacy amplitude backend; common tensor phase invisible in data
eta-prime uses established Alda:2026nrd tree generator and chi matrix, unchanged from gamma-gamma width
double-virtual BaBar amplitude is e squared times epsilon tensor F; abs(F) matches GeV inverse without extra factors
double-virtual broad bins evaluated at published average virtualities; source unfolding model dependence retained through quoted model errors
double-virtual central errors symmetrized in main fit; asymmetric statistical and upper-limit surrogate treatments stored separately

double_virtual_measurement.statistical_prescription: Primary Gaussian: arithmetic mean of upper and lower statistical errors, quadrature systematic and model errors. Sensitivity: split Gaussian with upper error for prediction above central value and lower otherwise.
double_virtual_measurement.covariance: No published covariance; all bins and systematic/model errors treated as diagonal. Independent of other measurement blocks.
double_virtual_measurement.bin_prescription: Evaluate at published efficiency-corrected average virtualities; broad-bin unfolding is source-model dependent, covered only by published model errors.
double_virtual_measurement.upper_limit_prescription: Sensitivity replaces central measurements in bins 2 and 5 by normalized Gaussian censoring deviance at the published 90 percent upper limits, with sigma=UL/1.2815515655446004. This is an assumed surrogate, not the published Poisson likelihood; central values and limits never counted together.
